CustomField.description: Whether a Start New Form or View/Edit Form Submission lookup shows its form inline or behind a button. Inline draws the form in place of the lookup. Modal shows a button, labelled by Reference Form Button Label, that opens the form in a window titled by the Reference Form Modal Header and Subheader. Ignored for the Standard and Form Component display types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Controls whether the form renders directly on the page or behind a button that opens it in a modal. Inline is the default and keeps the form always visible. Choose Modal when the embedded form is long and would otherwise dominate the page.
CustomField.label: referenceFormDisplayType
